Jules: Quick heads-up 1551 Kepler Health onboarding kickoff Friday 9:00am PT. Agenda: intros, tech handoff, pilot scope, success metrics, training slots. Invite sent. Please bring SSO contact + sample data snapshot.
Priya: Dropping the kickoff checklist + onboarding timeline here: https://redwood-internal/onboard/kepler (placeholder). I'll also attach a sample pilot SLA template.
Renee (Kepler): Confirming product + infra leads will be there (Marta, Ben). We'll try to get a sanitized dataset ready but might need help tokenizing PII.
Noah: Quick question 6A7 are we doing Hosted pilot or Dedicated? For initial validation Hosted usually ok. Also what's expected request shape/size?
Jules: Hosted pilot is fine. Expected baseline ~300 reqs/day rising to ~1k for short bursts. If traffic remains >3k/day for >2 weeks we evaluate Dedicated.
Noah: Great. I'll put together an integration smoke-test and a minimal curl example for them:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate/kepler" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<anonymized clinical note>","max_tokens":200}'
```
Renee (Kepler): We'll aim to upload sanitized samples by EOD Thursday. If we run into SSO delays can your team provide a service account for testing?
Priya: Yes, we can issue a time-limited service token for integration only. Note: prod access requires customer's SSO to be validated.
Jules: Proposed pilot success criteria (please comment): 1) Quality: >=90% pass on our blinded eval set; 2) Stability: 7-day run with error rate <1%; 3) Latency: p95 < 300ms for standard payloads; 4) Support: internal runbook + 1 enablement session completed.
Noah: Suggest adding rollback criteria and a canary plan: if error rate >1.5% or latency p95 >500ms during ramp, auto-fallback to baseline model. I'll draft the canary routing config.
Renee (Kepler): Sounds good. Also can we record the enablement session? Our support team will review recordings.
DeployBot: Calendar invite created for 1768490400 (Friday 9:00am PT) with Zoom link and agenda. :white_check_mark:
Jules: Action items: [Jules] finalize success criteria doc and share (today); [Noah] smoke-test + canary plan (Thu); [Renee] sanitized payloads + SSO contact (Thu EOD); [Priya] service token + pilot SLA draft (Thu). I'll own the risk register.
Priya: Renewal-risk flagging: low today but will re-evaluate after pilot quality check.
Renee (Kepler): Thanks all 680 excited to kick this off.
Jules: Closing kickoff thread for now 44D post any blockers here before the meeting.
